title: Governance event
description: One canonical, locally recorded governed finding or mediated action. Events are append-only and correction-by-supersession only, per Constitution Article 41. Recording is local-first and never depends on any remote projection; a projection acknowledgement can never alter event bytes.

event_id.description: Content-derived identity. Computed as canonical SHA-256 over every field of this event except event_id itself, truncated to 16 hex characters.

task_id.description: Null when the event is not bound to one task (round-level events).

authority_session_id.description: Chain identity. An AUTH-SESSION- value is a real, validated authority session. A DIRECT-CLI- value is a deterministic chain identity for direct invocations that declared a role but no session; it is derived, never minted per invocation, and is always labelled as such by session_source.

session_sequence.description: Per-authority-session monotonic sequence. Ordering is per session only; DEVAI never fabricates a global order across independent worktrees or disconnected hosts.

previous_event_digest_sha256.description: Digest of the preceding event in this session's chain; null for the first event of the session.

status.description: Outcome when the event kind carries one. Article 39: inconclusive is recorded rather than resolved into false precision.

commit_binding.description: Exact base and candidate identity, present only when the event kind is bound to a tree.

coverage.description: Article 6 host-boundary disclosure. DEVAI reports the boundary rather than implying control it does not possess.

mediated.description: True only for registered runtime actions and declared host-adapter events. Arbitrary editor or shell activity outside DEVAI is never covered and is never recorded as mediated.

public_safe_summary.description: Redacted, disclosure-profile-validated summary. Never contains raw prompts, command output, tokens, environment values, signing material, or sensitive paths.

evidence_refs.description: References to existing hash-chained evidence records. References only; payload bytes are never inlined.

payload_digest_sha256.description: Digest of the full local payload this event summarizes. Published in place of withheld content so a projection stays verifiable without disclosing it.

supersedes_event_id.description: Set only on evidence_superseded events. Correction is a new appended record; the superseded event is never edited or removed.

session_source.description: Provenance of the chain identity. Article 39: a direct-CLI chain is reported as what it is rather than presented as an authority session it never was.

examples.public_safe_summary: Owner authority session opened for round R-0042.
